name: Extra Instant Talent
body:
You are an expert in working with your symbiote to adapt to the conditions you face.

Prerequisite(s): instant talent class feature*.

Benefit(s): You can use your instant talent ability 1 additional time per day without incurring influence from your symbiote.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
